national_news.title: NTA Announces Re‑Test for UGC‑NET English, Commerce and Sociology Papers
bullets: NTA will conduct re‑tests for the UGC‑NET English, Commerce and Sociology papers due to identified errors in the original papers
The English and Commerce re‑tests are scheduled for 9 September (English 9:00‑12:00, Commerce 15:00‑18:00), while Sociology will be held on 10 September 9:00‑12:00
Candidates who appeared for the original papers must register for the re‑tests to qualify for the UGC‑NET certification

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Warns Doctors to Treat Patients Locally, Not Refer
bullets: Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urges state doctors to avoid unnecessary patient referrals by strengthening district hospitals
The state plans to equip district hospitals for more surgeries, aiming to provide comprehensive care closer to patients’ homes
The initiative seeks to improve the quality of life for Bihar residents by reducing travel and enhancing local healthcare infrastructure
